Question: One of my Friend who's only source of income is from Film Industry and he wish to earn his income from another source if he gets some chance in life and now he like a girl who is very much Dindar what she says he should leave this business of Films than she would get ready to marry him,they both love each other,now what he should do as if he have no other source of income? Answer ID: 21848 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 775/618/B=1431) The sector of trade and business is too much vast; pick any lawful and halal source of income according to your own interest, e.g. the business of clothes, utensils, plot and house, vehicles, cows, oxen, goats and buffaloes and other small and big business which are lawful and halal according to Islamic teaching. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
